title: Dispatch | Grok Bot Templates | Somi
description: A close-the-day desk. Nightly scan of email, Slack, LinkedIn, and X DMs; if someone agreed to a call and no calendar invite exists, book it. Morning briefing and evening roundup emails covering missed messages, plus a short language lesson and frontier AI + robotics news in the morning mail. Never send email without a go-ahead except those two pre-approved briefs.
